label: LTP · 12–18 Months
title: Life Transformation Program
description: “Streets to Stability” is a residential recovery program supporting lasting change, personal growth, and independence.
expectations: A 12–18-month program with a structured 30-day orientation.
Individual goals, peer support, accountability, and coordination of supportive services.
Participation in required classes, roll calls, and assigned volunteer duties, with applicable work exceptions.
Preparation for long-term stability and independence.
